output.headline: Runs in expensive peak hours
output.explanation: The dishwasher-like appliance usually starts in peak-price hours (07:00-10:00 and 17:00-21:00 local time), a consistent pattern. Over the 28 observed days, starting it after the peak could have saved 6.0 SEK if you have an hourly spot-price contract, for the same 12.1 kWh of use.
output.action: Next time, start it after the peak period ends instead of during it.
